name: Hitchcock Center Nature Summer Camp
description_short: An outdoor nature day camp at the Hitchcock Center on the Hampshire College campus in Amherst. Kids do hikes, animal observation, science and crafts. Nature Camp runs 8:45 AM–3:00 PM and serves rising K–6 graders. Chickadee Camp is a half-day program (8:45 AM–1:00 PM) for rising kindergartners. The Leadership Training Camp is for grades 7–9.
activities: Mud and dirt play, slime making
Field trips (by van or PVTA bus)
Caving, hikes and overnight camping (Leadership Training Camp)
refund_policy_summary: You can cancel yourself through your Active account. More than 90 days before your session starts: full refund minus a 6% platform fee. 30–90 days before: refund minus the $150 deposit. Less than 30 days before: no refund, unless the program is full and your spot gets filled, in which case you may get 50% back. There are no refunds for absences, sick days or vacations. Exceptions are made only for a health emergency, documented by a physician, that keeps the child out for the whole session.
special_needs_notes: The camp welcomes campers with social, emotional, physical, cognitive or behavioral challenges. If a child has a 1:1 aide at school, a 1:1 must also be provided at camp (a parent or guardian can do this). Campers must be able to move around on uneven terrain. Families should contact the Camp Director before enrolling to talk through accommodations. If needs are not disclosed, the child may be dismissed without a refund. Staff are trained to give EpiPens, and there is an individual health plan process for life-threatening allergies.
swim_waterfront_notes: No swimming program is mentioned. Campers bring a swimsuit and towel for sprinkler play only.
